scope: All seven frozen citation claims and all three ordinary body-flow bibliography keys were checked against the exact primary publication records and passages; bibliography coverage, user-library relevance, key consistency, and converged build diagnostics were also audited. The audit does not claim publication priority or peer review.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage frozen claim extraction followed by sequential primary-source search verification, exact passage replay, official metadata comparison, active-registry checksum binding, BibTeX/key consistency checks, and converged log inspection.
